d: In Amiens. A large square at the Porta di Parigi. A boulevard on the right. On the left a tavern with porch under which various tables are arranged for the adventurers. An external ladder leads to the first floor of the tavern. Students, Bourgeois, Populars, Women, Girls, Soldiers walk through the square and under the boulevard. Others are stopped in groups chatting. Others sit at the tables, drink and play. - Edmondo, surrounded by other Students, then Des Grieux.

In Paris. Very elegant living room in Geronte's house. In the bottom two doors. On the right, very rich and heavy curtains hide the alcove. On the left, near the window, a rich comb. Sofa, armchairs, a table. Manon is sitting in front of the comb: it is covered by a large white robe that envelops the whole person. The Hairdresser is busy around. Two Garzoni at the bottom are ready for the Hairdresser's notes.
The captivity, the journey to the Havre.

L'Havre. Square at the harbor. In the bottom, the port: on the left, the corner of a barracks. On the side of the ground floor, a window with large protruding irony. In the façade towards the square, the closed door, before which walks a Sentinel. - The sea occupies the entire bottom of the scene. You see half of a warship. On the right, a house, then a lane; on the corner, an oil headlight that lightens weakly. It is the last hour of the night; the sky will go gradually risking. Des Grieux with Lescaut, on the opposite side of the barracks.

In America. An exterminated land on the borders of the territory of the New Orléans. Land bare and wavy; vast horizon; clouded sky. - Falls in the evening. Manon and Des Grieux slowly advance from the bottom: they are poorly dressed: they look like grappling people: Manon pale, exhausted, leans over Des Grieux, who sustains it with effort.
